tagline.en_US: Vscodium-web is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of the remote host web component of Microsoft's editor VS Code.

description.en_US: Vscodium Web is a community-driven, freely-licensed distribution of the remote host web component of the VS Code editor. It provides a full-featured code editor accessible directly within a web browser. Users can write code, manage files, and access an integrated terminal without needing a local desktop client.

tips: For GitHub integration, open a terminal from the top menu to set your Git username and email.
